## Findings
- claim-1: The source states that Theorem 5.4 gives two generating sets for \(J_v\), with \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\) and \(b=\min(i,j)\). [source-6@L14-L21|claim=ordinary-document]
- claim-2: For \(r\)-Grassmannian data, \(J_v\) is generated in \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) by the Schur classes \(s_\mu\) with \(i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(n-r)^r\). [source-2@L1365-L1375|claim=formal-document]
- claim-3: In the \((i,j,p,c)=(2,2,2,3)\) interval, the complete integral Pieri computation gives \(J/\Lambda_+J\cong\mathbb Z^6\), with nonzero free quotient ranks \(1,1,2,1,1\) in degrees \(4,5,6,7,8\), respectively, and no torsion. [artifact 4d073f3d77472c01e4aab7680d125484749048e7697fdb8e3cd287017c08dc5c]
- claim-4: Both six-element families \[ \mathcal F_{\rm top}=\{s_{22},s_{32},s_{42},s_{33},s_{43},s_{44}\}, \quad \mathcal F_{\rm bot}=\{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\} \] are minimal generating sets of \(J_{2,3}\).
- claim-5: The requested \(i=j=p=2,\ c=3\) minimality corollary is established.
## Strategy
Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,4}\) and write \(\bar s_\lambda\) for Schur classes. The accepted interval presentation identifies
\[
J_{2,3}=\bigoplus_{(2,2)\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(4^5)}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda .
\]
Here \(a=b=2\), hence \(N=\binom{a+b}{a}=6\). The known generating families are
\[
\mathcal F_{\rm top}=\{\bar s_{22},\bar s_{32},\bar s_{42},
\bar s_{33},\bar s_{43},\bar s_{44}\},
\]
\[
\mathcal F_{\rm bot}=\{\bar s_{22},\bar s_{221},\bar s_{222},
\bar s_{2211},\bar s_{2221},\bar s_{2222}\}.
\]
By accepted task 142,
\[
J_{2,3}/\Lambda_+J_{2,3}\cong\mathbb Z^6.
\]
Each six-element family generates \(J_{2,3}\), so its images give a surjection
\(\mathbb Z^6\twoheadrightarrow J_{2,3}/\Lambda_+J_{2,3}\cong\mathbb Z^6\).
By task 130’s implication, this map is unimodular; therefore the images form a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis. No proper subfamily can generate the quotient, hence none can generate \(J_{2,3}\). Thus both displayed families are minimal generating sets.

Accordingly, the requested \(i=j=p=2,\ c=3\) minimality corollary is established relative to the stated accepted project inputs.
